commit.message:
Prompt for removing active toga (projectNoob)

Removing Victory resets its bonuses, so prompt when doing that.

Fix a rare tentacle connect issue

Every turn, a tentacle decides where to move its tip, and then lays out
its segments to be a legal tentacle. If it fails in this step, we log a
tentacle connection failure and kill the whole thing. This has been
happening recently in Gulch in particular, for reasons that are unclear
but may be related to the isolated blockages that fungus causes, and/or
their regrowth mechanics.

One way this can happen (which may or may not be responsible for the
recent failures) is that we fail to preserve the "no holes" invariant
that tentacles enforce. And *that* happened because of the layout code;
the tip moved somewhere which respects the no holes rule, but then the
body then took an option which does not.

So we fix this by enforcing holelessness on layouts, as well as in the
tip's destination. This should avoid holes for tentacles whose base has
not moved. If the base has moved, there may be cases where the only
valid route has a hole; so in order not to cause new connect failures,
we fall back to a search which allows holes.

We also add comments explaining the algorithm a little, though the
author increasingly suspects that it was folly to attempt to bind the
ineffable tentacle with mere strings of code.

Don't crash when shafting Nobody

An actor getting shafted while pending revival would cause a game crash when
the fineff to revive them fired. This was (probably) only possible for Nobody,
who blinks when reviving. To avoid and somewhat future-proof this, blink after
scheduling the fineff and prohibit monsters that are pending revival from
triggering shafts.

Closes #4555

Fix ctrl+f inventory item preview

Ctrl+f and then selecting an inventory item was previewing equipping the
item (which does nothing) rather than removing it. We fix this by no
longer marking stash search copies as not in the inventory. The purpose
of this was to prevent you interacting with such items; we fix that by
directly checking whether items are copies.

Fixes #5444

Nerf the roachtagon (paperrat)

This vault placed a large number of cockroaches that were turned into
clockroaches when those were added. While D:4-5 is within clockroach
native depth, placing 5-15 of them in one room was a bit excessive.
Move this vault deeper, to D:6-8, and reduce the number of roaches
by 2.

Closes #5446.

Let fear actually affect plants (pisastrish)

75901e3 enabled plants to get fear and berserk status, but fear was always
immediately removed in the mon-behv function.

Closes #5417.

Fix a wizmode crash (aliscans)

Creating an aspiring flesh did not set the protean target property, which
caused a mon-info crash. While it might be nice to set up the property so
that wizmode aspiring fleshes transform properly, for now we can at least
not crash wizmode.

Improve englaciation min duration

Make it feel a bit better when it actually works.

Improve and clarify intoxicate duration

Pull the duration roll out from the default mon_enchant rolls, which are
extremely opaque and really should not be used anymore. Buff the minimum
roll slightly because it was really short. The distribution has also been
changed, but I'm not going to try and describe it because that requires
understanding how fuzz_value works.

This spell is likely to get reworked in the future.

Fix unequip delays being uninterruptible

8e159b2 updated unequip delays to prevent them generating spurious
interrupt warnings after unequip. However, it accidentally made them
never fire interrupt warnings at all.

We fix this reverting that change, and instead adding a way for delays
to suppress all interrupts, and use it for the finish() phase of
EquipOffDelay.

Fix typo in arena.txt

[Committer's note: Adjusted commit message.]

Clarify that aqua form has blood

This is a bit surprising, but evidently intended. Closes #4782.

Fix vampire form lifesteal ignoring rN (tekkud)

This never had an rN check to downscale the amount healed (like most
vampirism does), so when a number of vampirism checks were changed by
f76b1d3 (to rely on the rN check instead), it suddenly became able to heal
fully by biting undead and nonliving monsters.

(And since they didn't have a proper blood_name(), you got wonderful
messages like "You sink your fangs into the large abomination and drink
its ???")

Add another lowly thing to Halloween messages.

And remove an unneeded blank line.

Reduce gnoll magic apts (again)

Gnolls are still overperforming a bit. We'd like gnolls to actually use more of
the non-magical tools at their disposal and have a little more trouble getting
strong enough to just blast through the midgame with magic, and their level 1
on spell backgrounds is also ludicrously strong. Reduce spellcasting to +7 and
spell schools to +5 to course correct on this a little bit.

Fix some armour ego bugs (pym505)

Oops.
We are electing not to add the test functions at this time.
Closes #5428.

Reorder and update Russian descriptions

----------

Remove obsolete Russian descriptions and match English order.

The ru/ description files were last updated several versions ago and
still carry entries for content that no longer exists: the Bows,
Crossbows, Slings, Transmutations and Poison Magic skills (since merged
or renamed), the Centaur, Deep Dwarf, Halfling, Hill Orc, Ogre and
Vampire species, the Abyssal Knight, Arcane Marksman, Assassin,
Transmuter and Venom Mage backgrounds, and CMD_PRAY. The game never
looks these keys up, and they make it hard to see what still needs
translating.

Entries are also reordered to follow the English source files. The ru/
files had drifted into the ordering of an older version, which made
comparing a translation against its original needlessly awkward.
Keeping the order in sync means future translation diffs show only the
text that actually changed.

----------

Translate Russian descriptions for current skills, species, branches.

Adds 45 Russian descriptions that had no translation, bringing five
files to full coverage against the English source: skills.txt (29/29),
species.txt (27/27), backgrounds.txt (26/26), commands.txt (96/96)
and branches.txt (37/37).

These are the entries a player meets first, so they were the most
visible gaps. Character creation showed English for eight species
(Coglin, Djinni, Gale Centaur, Kobold, Mountain Dwarf, Oni,
Poltergeist, Revenant) and eight backgrounds (Alchemist, Brigand,
Cinder Acolyte, Delver, Forgewright, Hexslinger, Reaver,
Shapeshifter), and the skill menu showed English for the four skills
that replaced the ones removed in the previous commit. branches.txt
was missing every portal and extradimensional branch, sixteen in all,
among them the Abyss, Pandemonium, the Depths and Ziggurats.

Terminology follows the existing translation wherever it had already
made a choice: Hexslinger is built on the name the Hexes school
already carries, Mountain Dwarf reuses the word Deep Dwarf used for
"dwarf", and Depths keeps the form the Hell entry already used for
it. The Ice Cave Lua conditional is carried over structurally
unchanged, with only its two string literals translated.

Quotes are left untranslated on purpose, as docs/develop/translation.txt
asks.

----------

Fix a typo in the Russian description of the Shoals.

The word for "exotic" was missing a letter. Spotted while checking the
rest of this branch's changes in a running game.

----------

Update three Russian descriptions that no longer matched the game.

All three keep their keys, so a key-level check calls them translated
while the text says something the game no longer does.

Earth Magic said the school is linked with Transmutations. That school
is gone; the English entry now says Alchemy.

Throwing described blowguns and magic needles, neither of which
exists any more, and closed by saying the skill works together with
Slings, a skill that has since been merged into Ranged Weapons. It is
now a translation of what the English entry currently says.

Oni began with the species name, which in Russian is spelled exactly
like the pronoun "they", so the first line read as "They are large,
sturdy..." rather than as a name. The sentence now opens with the
adjectives, which is what most entries in this file already do.

Spotted while checking this branch's changes in a running game.

----------

Split the Russian CMD_IGNORE_INVISIBLE entry to follow #5433.

The Russian file mirrored the English one, where the verbose text sat
inside the short entry with only a blank line between them. #5433 has
since fixed the English side by adding the missing %%%%, so the
Russian needs the same separator; without it the Russian verbose text
stays unreachable while the English one works.

----------

Restore content missing from Russian item descriptions.

Fifteen entries in ru/items.txt had lost most of what the English says.
The key is there and the text is in Russian, so a key-level check calls
them translated, but a player reading them does not learn what the item
does.

The worst were potions and scrolls, which are read constantly and where
a missing drawback can cost a character. potion of berserk rage said
only that it causes an incoherent rage: nothing about being unable to
move or attack outside melee, nothing about the fatigue afterwards or
the inability to berserk again. scroll of fear omitted which monsters
are immune. scroll of teleportation omitted that reading it again
cancels a pending teleport. potion of mutation omitted that it removes
mutations before granting new ones.

potion of invisibility had also dropped its [[player invis desc]]
include, which is the block explaining how invisibility actually
behaves, and that block had no Russian entry at all; it is translated
here.

Found by comparing markup, paragraph count and length against the
English entries.

----------

Restore content missing from Russian spell descriptions.

Seventeen entries in ru/spells.txt had lost most of what the English
says, and several had drifted far enough to be actively wrong.

Invisibility was the worst: the Russian described contamination
building up and making the caster glow back into visibility, which the
game no longer does, and said nothing about the accuracy, evasion and
blocking penalties the current entry is about. Fulminant Prism
described a prism draining magic from its surroundings rather than the
unstable gold alloy that explodes, and omitted that destroying it early
weakens the blast. Teleport Other said the target moves at random
rather than out of the caster's sight after a delay. Force Lance
described a knockback conditioned on the target's defences instead of
the extra damage from being slammed into a wall or another creature.

The rest were omissions of things a caster needs to know: that Freeze
bypasses armour, that Sticky Flame is put out if the victim moves and
will not stick to insubstantial targets, that Shatter is weak against
flying, gelatinous and insubstantial creatures, that Sting poisons even
resistant targets, that Static Discharge bypasses half of armour, that
Blink cannot be recast for a while, that Cause Fear ends when the
target leaves line of sight, and that Leda's Liquefaction shrinks over
time and slows the caster too.

Found by comparing markup, paragraph count and length against the
English entries. The file went from 24 flagged entries to 8, with none
of the remaining ones missing content.

----------

Closes #5432.
Closes #5436.
Closes #5437.
Closes #5438.

[Committer's note: Adjusted/consolidated commit messages, squashed.]

Attribute some peripheral damage directly to the player

Solar ember, battlesphere, and rending blade damage now counts as being
dealt by the owner of those things rather than the peripheral monster
itself. This is consistent with how damage from foxfire, ball lightning,
orbs of destruction, and other similar things are also attributed directly
to the actor who first created them.
Add a few more names to artefacts.

Refactor enchant_weapon().

It now matches the structure of enchant_armour(), since the two
functions are meant to do the same thing, albeit for two different types
of items. This also makes the code somewhat more readable.

Refactor is_enchantable_weapon().

It now matches the structure of is_enchantable_armour(), since the two
functions are meant to do the same thing, albeit for two different types
of items. This also makes the code somewhat more readable.

Refactor is_enchantable_armour() a bit.

The new logic accounts for the case of unknown, unidentified random
artefact armour when you have the artefact enchanting mutation, which
the old logic did not, and which the equivalent logic in
is_enchantable_weapon() did.

Also clarify a few comments.

Make enchant_armour() match enchant_weapon() more

Make incrementing a variable use postfix (although either works),
rename a variable, and add a comment.
Remove unnecessary parentheses.

Rename a variable.

So that it more closely matches the corresponding function for armour.
Remove unneeded blank line.
Add smell test to Forgewarden's cuirass desc.

fix: Blorkula mitosis bug(Nnyef)

If Blorkula the Orcula split into bats and one of the bats was shafted,
that vampire bat would turn into a copy of Blorkula on another
floor complete with duplicated gear!

Make Blorkula's bats shaft immune to prevent this.

Remove now-inaccurate comment.

The comment says that the hint about wielding a melee weapon applies to
rangers (dating back to the days when attacking with a ranged weapon in
melee range would clumsily bash the monster instead of shooting), but it
now applies to any player wielding something possibly inappropriate
(such as if the player tries to attack unarmed while having an
appropriate melee weapon in their inventory).

Split out the Ranger's melee hint key

Two different hints shared the key HINT_WIELD_WEAPON. The one reached
from fight.cc, when a Ranger is about to melee something while
wielding a launcher, tells the player they can switch back to the
weapon in slot a. The one reached from the description of an
unequipped weapon tells them how to wield it.

_add_entry() stores descriptions with dbm_store(..., DBM_REPLACE), so
the entry that appears later in hints.txt wins. That is the weapon
description text, which means the Ranger hint has been unreachable
since f0ccbfa403 externalised the second text under the key the first
was already using.

This renames the Ranger hint to HINT_WIELD_MELEE_WEAPON, which also
says more clearly what it is for, and leaves HINT_WIELD_WEAPON to the
weapon description. Renaming the enumerator does not affect saves:
hints_events is indexed by position and its compatibility check is on
HINT_EVENTS_NUM, neither of which changes here.

Follow-up to #5434.

[Committer's note: Adjusted commit message, made sure both
HINT_WIELD_WEAPON and HINT_WIELD_MELEE_WEAPON have separate entries
in hints.h, and kept binary compatibility when doing so.]
Add SeijiOokami to the credits.

Remove two shadowed duplicate description entries

monstatus.txt defines "damage-immune at range monstatus" twice, and
mutations.txt defines "+LOS mutation" twice. Each pair describes the
same thing in different words, and each key names a single game
object: MB_WARDING in mon-info-flag-name.h and one "+LOS" entry in
mutation-data.h.

_add_entry() stores descriptions with dbm_store(..., DBM_REPLACE), so
the later entry wins and the earlier one is dead text that no player
can reach. In both cases the later entry is also the more detailed
one, so this removes the earlier entry and leaves what the game
already shows unchanged.

The duplicates came from later descriptions being written without
noticing the key was taken: e78965e76f for the monster status and
ef7f3e67aa for the mutation.

Found while scanning dat/descript for the problem fixed in #5433.

Fix two unreachable entries in commands.txt

Both entries are present in the file but the database never serves
them, because of how they are delimited.

CMD_EXPLORE_NO_REST appears twice. The second occurrence is plainly
the verbose description, but it repeats the plain key instead of
using CMD_EXPLORE_NO_REST verbose, so the long text describing the
explore_auto_rest behaviour is a duplicate key rather than the
verbose entry it was meant to be.

CMD_IGNORE_INVISIBLE verbose sits inside the CMD_IGNORE_INVISIBLE
entry, separated only by a blank line instead of %%%%. Its text is
therefore part of the short description rather than an entry of its
own.

[Committer's note: Adjusted commit message.]

Give very ugly things rPois+/rElec+ (Predelnik).

Since those resistances are now either single-level or complete
immunity, drop their current double resistance to them, as was already
done with rCorr back when it was rAcid.

Closes #5430.
Improve monster def docs for energy and resists

Fix erroneous documentation for monster YAML defs

Discovered while attempting to parse monster YAML files

Remove accidental `genus` duplications

Found in both necrophage.yaml and searing-wretch.yaml

Do not clear MIDs when initialising monsters (rypofalem, Wizard Ike)

When calling init_with on a monster, we were resetting them. Since
3667fe4, this reset evicts them from the MID cache as well as clearing
the monster attributes. This was a problem for (at least) Kirke's hogs,
who were ending up not in the cache when they reverted to human form.
Now, we clear their attributes but do not evict them from the MID cache.

Remove obsolete piety decay references from hints

And replace them with references to spending piety, which is the only
way to lose piety now aside from violating religious rules.

Fix wizmode local placement sometimes giving incorrect tiles

If called during level generation, dgn_place_map would just place a
vault. However, if called outside level generation to place a vault on
an existing level, it would reset everything that needs reseting at the
start of level generation then place the vault and then do the fixup
steps that need to happen at the end of level generation. Unfortunately,
if you used it to place a vault with subvaults into an existing level,
it would be used to place the subvaults and would reset everything that
is reset at the start of level generation when placing the subvaults
resulting in the initial vault sometimes getting incorrect tiles or
terrain heights.

Instead make dgn_place_map always just place a vault and add a new
function to handle adding a vault to an existing level. This way when
dgn_place_map is used to place the subvaults it won't reset anything
that's still in use.

Fix a tentacle beam crash

91ee021 changed eldritch tentacles to clean up tentacle portals
correctly on death. This exposed a bug whereby beams would crash,
because they did not expect solid cells to become non-solid while
processing them. This expectation seems reasonable, so we fix this by
deferring the terrain change to a fineff.

Be more explicit about fortress crab's ego-doubling effect (Acrobat)

In the talisman description (the mutation screen was already plenty
explicit).

There is a mild ongoing awkwardness where the detailed description of many
bespoke form properties are only available if you actually put the talisman
on. Some of them are hard to shoehorn into the item description without
being either vague or incredibly wordy. I wonder if there's any way to
make those popup sub-descriptions accessible from the item itself?

Fix TSO's holy warrior summon lasting 1/10th as long as intended (acrobat)

Turns versus aut strikes again.
Fix comment typo.

Fix Trog's Hand tooltip (dolorous)

status_light_description assumed no spaces in the status text. We need to
special case Trog's Hand so that it pulls up the correct db entry.

Fixes #3821.

Make derived undead monsters use the original head count

Previously, spectral and zombie hydra/slymdra used the head count of
their live version on death, while yred's bound soul rerolled the head
count.

Using the version on death is slightly problematic because it
incentivises head farming - especially for the more permanent bound
souls. So we standardise these to use the original head count of the
hydra.

Fixes #4115

New unrands for the 'new' armour egos (#5423)

- +8 Arcane Splint Mail, a chainmail unrand that grants Archery and
coronas enemies hit by projectiles (even thrown items, if you are allergic to
using archery).
- +6 bone scales, a Death pds modified to have plate level encumbrance
(so it gives plate stats while being wearable by offsize species, sort of
like armour of Talos but in a more useful way). Also grants a bunch of other
properties, but banes on equip.
- +12 Forgewarden's cuirass, a Resonance plate that comes with an enhancer
but reduces piety gain because it was blasphemously devoted to a certain god
that does not exist.

commit.message: Fix Homebrew's GitHub Actions reference

Let the player know where they've been shafted

This can be useful to know, e.g. when deciding whether to explore more
of the dungeon before doing lair/orc. So we add an indicator for which
branches you've been shafted in, which also serves the purpose of
(somewhat) explaining this mechanic exists.

Fix a couple more things involving known-invisible monsters

They should now be accounted for by nearby enemy checks for reading
scrolls and warnings for inadequate space when trying to summon things.

Fix being unable to attack known-invisible monsters when stationary (Ge0FF)

(Without using ctrl+direction or autofight, at least.)
Fix punctuation.

Add another adjective to gizmos; fix a comment.

(The names of both cobalt and nickel reference luckless German miners
versus goblins.)
Add a few more gizmo adjectives.

Rework death ego (#5412)

It was a bit too narrow and very unpopular.

Remove the hp loss on casting non-necro spells, reduce the wizardry
bonus, and provide a chance to drain some HP from adjacent enemies when
casting a necro spell. Maybe more interesting/better.

commit.message: fix tense

Make newly enchanted wpns/armour use proper tiles

(This is the same idea as #5177, but implemented differently; it marks
newly enchanted items using item_set_appearance(), the same way that
newgame_make_item() does with enchanted items the player starts with.
Thus, such items are marked as either glowing or runed.)
Checkwhite.

Remove a redundantly set parameter.

Since effect is already true by default in monster::del_ench(), we don't
need to explicitly set it to true when removing the haunted enchantment
from a pacified monster.

Remove bullseye target from pacified monsters.

So that you don't keep shooting a monster you pacify under Ely, or an
orc you convert through violence under Beogh.

Closes #5415.

Remove obsolete Yredelemnul piety hint.

It hasn't applied since Yredelemnul was revamped to use traditional
piety in 18fcfa0.

Externalise remaining hint text

[Committer's note: Squashed and edited commit message, removed a few
unneeded blank lines, fixed one missing period.]
Fix typos.

Buff Archery ego (again)

Add a little bit (1%) bonus ranged damage per level of armour skill.

This commit also refactors the resonance damage mod for clarity.

Fix monster Searing Ray sometimes continuing a turn while confused (Dossy)

The check for interruptions was done before clouds affect a monster on
their turn, meaning that it was possible for a Searing Ray caster to get
confused by a meph cloud and still continue their spell for one more turn
before noticing they were confused.

Instead, check for interruptions at the moment it tries to continue the
spell.

(Also, do a little refactoring of other similar interruption checks in
general.)

This fixes #5411

Allow summoned monsters to generate with throwing nets

Now that this scenario no longer needs to be avoided (as of the previous
commit), there's no reason to ban summoned gnolls from having nets.

Fix handling of summoned throwing nets (Flugkiller)

Throwing nets held by summoned monsters operated as if they were real, but
would spam the log with debug errors once one actually landed on the ground
(since summoned objects are supposed to disappear as soon as a monster
stops holding them).

This problem was mostly avoided in past by not giving throwing nets to
summoned monsters at all (if, say, the player got one via ?summoning), but
if Bane of Multiplicity cloned a monster with a net, the summoned clone
would also have nets. This was probably also possible via other means to
clone monsters as well.

Now thrown nets by summoned monsters will be treated properly as 'fake' net
(similar to how net traps work), disappearing whenever they would hit the
ground but otherwise functioning properly.

Fix aqua form + axes interaction (Ogregutan)

Since 083d3cb, when use of targeter_cleave was restored, aqua form lost its
ability to reach with cleaving weapons. This commit restores that (as well
as explicating on v that you cleave in melee range even when reaching
further away.)

Make shopkeeper names more random

They have three random bytes, but only used two of them, limiting us to
only 40,000 possible shopkeeper names.

To preserve existing names, existing shops copy their second byte into
their (previously unused) third byte.

Apply crab form bonus to resonance and command

Also to the fire and ice scale unrands' school wizardry (can revert if
unwanted).

Death ego is unchanged because it is probably getting reworked soon.

Rework resonance ego. (#4940)

Resonance ego now increases damage only when meleeing something adjacent to 
one of your constructs. The damage has been increased to its old value of 2% per 
Forgecraft skill level. Positional Gameplay tm.

Unrands for 'special' weapon brands (#5398)

Adds unrands for the specialty weapon brands of each weapon type.
I have tried to double down on the brand gimmick where possible, in addition
to rounding out unused base types (gsc, short sword, scimitar, and bardiche).

- The giant spiked club "Carina at Dusk," a +9 concussive GSC that spawns a 
shooting star when knocking an enemy back, and 1/4th of the time otherwise.
Really high damage, really able to push stuff.
- The coolibah bardiche, a +6 entangling bardiche that can apply flooded status
and/or put a bog under constricted enemies. Doesn't matter what the constrict
source is, so feel free to combine it with a wand of roots. Locking enemies in 
place over a bog should feel rewarding, though fliers are immune of course.
- The Staff of Five Virtues, a +5 lajatang of rebuke that provides additional 
base SH when certain strategic thresholds are met, and gives reflection and 
an extra block if at least three thresholds are. Can turn the xp savings of
using a lajatang into a huge amount of defensive power.
- The Stagehand's Sword, a +7 devious short sword that sometimes grants
temporary invisibility, depending on how devious you are. Ideally can let you
chain together stabs to stack max devious easily, but won't start the chain for 
you.
- Hana's Scimitar, a +10 scimitar of valour that additionally grants archmagi
when your MP is 80% full or more. Please enjoy a big opening burst of damage
on your "hybrid" "battlemage" or "wide" characters.
- in lieu of a new axe, the Wrath of Trog gains a sundering brand, which is
able to activate faster than normal and maintain some of its charge through
non-attacks if you are berserk (and behaves as normal sundering if you aren't 
berserk). Its other properties are unchanged. This version of Wrath of Trog 
should explode the screen very nicely if you're berserking.

All of the new unrands are using palette swapped default tiles for now.
Naturally, balance may be adjusted in the future.

commit.message:
Fix a bug with david_glass_crypt

The pressure plates weren't disappearing due to calling the wrong feature name.
fix minor staff desc typo

Show status tooltips in local tiles

This adds tooltips similar to those in webtiles (except they don't do
formatting).

It also makes very small fixes to the text of tooltips on both platforms
(fixing the string for no description + expiring, and trimming the
string).

Replace a std::map.emplace with an insert

CAO doesn't tolerate such new-fangled methods

Fix a bug with penance titles

Good gods don't penance you unless you join an evil (or chaotic with Zin) god
but were applying the traitor title regardless of religion if you abandoned for
any non-good god. Rather annoying, since the penance would last forever in that
case and prevent getting any other title. Check that wrath is active for good
god penance titles to avoid this behavior.

Improve magical staff description (Ix-risor) (#5403)

Display magical staff damage and activation chance beneath the damage
rating line.

Additionally, adjust which Ru skill sacrifices change messaging. Before,
we gave a message about not being able to fully use the staff when the
staff school was sacrificed even though you could get bonus staff damage
from evocations alone, and we didn't give a message for sacrifice
artifice, which completely prevents bonus staff damage even though you
could otherwise get it from the magic school alone. We now display a
special message only for sacrifice artifice instead.

Closes #5009.

commit.message:
Display frenzy's increased melee damage on xv again

After eedf646 compressed the frenzied status's might and berserk effects
into itself, lacking either made the monster xv screen not display the
increased melee damage of monsters; this fixes it by adding frenzy to the
same spot might and berserk adjust displayed melee damage.

Remove an obsolete safety check

Stabs no longer wake monsters, so the path that led to this guard is
gone (and I can see no other possible way calculating damage can kill a
monster)

Remove stale comments about spectral weapons

Removes various comments obsoleted by 95c4dbd.

I think it is still possible to hit the defensive checks these comments
refer to - pacified monsters on stairs do it. These are hard to achieve
as the monsters usually just go up stairs without standing on them, but
it is certainly doable in wizmode and I reckon probably with dispersal
traps.

Move spectral weapon removal into remove_summons (DracoOmega)

This makes the weapons get properly removed in cases such as charming
(whereas previously they would stick around with their owner's old
attitude).

Remove spectral weapons when unequipping the Glaive of the Guard

It sneakily lacks the spectral brand.

Prevent orphaned spectral weapons

Previous to this commit, it was possible to have spectral weapons with
no summoners, which would be cleaned up by handle_behaviour. This was a
bit unexpected - unsuspecting callers trying to alert a monster could
end up with that monster unexpectedly dying. Example times this happened
included when banishing a monster and, prior to the parent commit, when
the monster was disarmed.

In this commit, we make sure we remove any spectral weapon summoned by a
monster as soon as that monster gets cleaned up (at the same place in
the code that we clear up their summons), and so no longer need this
special cleanup step in handle_behaviour. We also stop spectral weapons
from following the player up and down stairs (which they would
previously do without their owner, though their cleanup made this hard
to notice).

In the usual case this is a no-op; monsters who die in the normal way
and are still holding their spectral weapon already dismissed it on
death.

Don't create spectral weapons from dropped weapons

We were creating spectral weapons from weapons the monster had dropped
if they were disarmed in the same attack, due to fineff ordering.

Fix off-by-one in reaching range check (Odds).

It was 1 higher than it should have been, which made all dancing
weapons erroneously display as polearms in console mode due to
erroneously calculating a reach range of at least 2.

Closes #5404.

Reduce cases of allies just glaring at unreachable foes (ogregutan, Odds)

If a foe came into view of the player, while an ally existed that couldn't
yet see that foe, and that foe was unreachable to them (eg: behind grates),
said ally would often freeze in place and refuse to approach - even when
commanded to attack the enemy directly.

The issue is that allies can get foes fed to them based on player vision,
and when their foe isn't in LoS, they attept to perform pathfinding on
them. When that (correctly) failed to find a path, they would... just stand
still.

Instead, set their target to the foe's position, which should make them
try to approach as close as they can get (which is the behavior that
hostile monsters already have in most similar cases).

Fix Hep permanent ability default letters

Following 9183a2, recall/transference/idealise moved from abc to aef, as
bcd were being reserved for class selection (though class selection
didn't actually use them).
Add another Singing Sword line.

Improve shaft self description

Mention that you can't use it on stairs or in water.

Add another word to Crazy Yiuf speech.

Taken from Mark Twain's "Extract from Captain Stormfield's Visit to
Heaven."
